name: S P Setia Berhad
overview: 今年公司推进出售约275.40英亩永久地契土地给Mah Sing Group Berhad的全资子公司，交易条件先决期限经两次延长至2026年12月2日；同时解散日本子公司Setia Osaka Tokutei Mokuteki Kaisha及完成Setia EM (Central) Sdn Bhd的自愿清盘，以精简营运。最新一季（2026年9月30日）营收同比下滑22.9%，净利润同比下滑52.1%。
overview_en: During the year, the company progressed the proposed disposal of approximately 275.40 acres of freehold land to wholly-owned subsidiaries of Mah Sing Group Berhad, with the conditional period for fulfilment of conditions precedent extended twice to 2 December 2026; it also dissolved its Japanese subsidiary Setia Osaka Tokutei Mokuteki Kaisha and concluded the members' voluntary winding-up of Setia EM (Central) Sdn Bhd to streamline operations.

actions.text: 上述土地出售的先决条件期限再延长一个月，从2026年11月3日延至2026年12月2日。
actions.text_en: The conditional period for the above land disposal was further extended by one month from 3 November 2026 to 2 December 2026.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Setia EM (Central) Sdn Bhd于2026年8月4日举行最终会议，结束成员自愿清盘，并将向马来西亚公司委员会及破产管理署提交申报，公司将在申报后三个月解散。
actions.text_en: Setia EM (Central) Sdn Bhd held its final meeting on 4 August 2026 to conclude its members' voluntary winding-up and will lodge the return with the Companies Commission of Malaysia and the Official Receiver;

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司Setia Osaka Tokutei Mokuteki Kaisha于2026年6月10日召开特别股东大会决议解散，作为精简营运及优化成本效率的一部分。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Setia Osaka Tokutei Mokuteki Kaisha held an extraordinary general meeting on 10 June 2026 and resolved to dissolve, as part of efforts to streamline operations and optimise cost efficiencies.
